entries.test: Public corporate statements, job classifications, and staffing policies could establish whether perceived AI substitutability leads executives to reclassify increasing amounts of labor as unskilled despite poor output quality.
entries.note: The theoretical capability is the asserted rationale for reclassification, rather than a probability hedge on the causal claim.

entries.test: Public accounts of corporate automation and customer-service experiments, including their financial results, would show whether companies test reductions in human involvement and customer experience to identify when those reductions start losing money.
entries.note: This is a firm forecast of observable corporate experimentation with no stated deadline.
